lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You win, Jake. I signed the transfer papers, just leave my sister Mia alone.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Smart nurse, Harper. Now walk away from my half-brother Cole and never look back.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I can't believe Cole hid the fact that he's a billionaire Whitmore heir for a full year.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Harper, wait, I can explain everything about why I kept my identity a secret from you!

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Don't touch me, Cole! My husband is dead to me, go back to your CEO tower.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: If the flash drive is destroyed, I need to find another way to prove Diane poisoned grandmother Evelyn.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Wait, Evelyn's old medical records were hidden in this exact toolbox by the mechanic.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: The toxicology report proves stepmother Diane murdered her.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Too bad you won't live to show it to the board, brother.
